load_mse_metric: load the mse metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library for regression evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for interactive mse metric evaluation
run_mse_evaluation: run the mse metric on predictions and references to compute mean squared error
build_mse_metric_pipeline: build a pipeline that loads the mse metric and evaluates model predictions
test_mse_metric: test the mse metric by loading it via evaluate.load and computing error on sample data
